question: Should exec/process/node-host tool results redact secret-shaped payloads by default before reaching agent-visible content/details/context, or must this PR add an explicit raw-output reveal path first?
rationale: The implementation is supported by source review and proof, but automation should not decide the permanent security boundary and byte-exact output compatibility policy for existing agent workflows.

options.title: Accept default redaction now
options.body: Merge the current default-redaction behavior as the safer boundary and design any explicit raw reveal path as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Require reveal path before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to add a narrow permissioned raw-output reveal mechanism and tests before changing the default contract.

options.title: Reject default redaction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide byte-exact exec/process output must remain the default agent-visible contract.

recommendation.title: Accept default redaction now
recommendation.body: Merge the current default-redaction behavior as the safer boundary and design any explicit raw reveal path as a separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent exec/process ownership and the PR discussion both point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the maintainer/security call.
